name: Atal Tunnel
facts: The Atal Tunnel, stretching 9.02 kilometres, became the world’s longest single‑tube highway tunnel above 10,000 feet when it opened in October 2020, cutting the Manali‑Keylong journey from six hours to just two.

Construction began on 28 June 2010 after a 2000 announcement by Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee, and the two ends finally met on 13 October 2017, a milestone celebrated by Defence Minister Nirmala Sitharaman.

During its build, the tunnel faced relentless water ingress—up to 3,000,000 litres per day in 2012—requiring constant dewatering and sophisticated rock‑stabilisation, yet it still completed 7.6 kilometres of excavation by December 2016.
